# create-two-centres

Two wants from two postcodes map to the two seeded centres (Chichester, Redhill), the card's
"a point from the user's postcode (through location), mapped to the nearest grid centre, verified or
not". The GPU criterion resolves to its catalogue family (RTX 40) in `v_want_terms_by_centre`; the
RAM criterion names no term. A paid entitlement makes both wants count as paid. `v_want_areas`
rounds each point to the 0.05° grid and flags the want that accepts a posted item.
